paite: Ka diktanna Pathian aw, ka hon sap chiang in hon dawng in; ka mangbat chiang in, nang na hon hih navak zel a; ka tung ah zahngai inla, ka thumna hon ngaihkhiaksak in.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La: Kaihging Gui Nei A Tum Ding / Panpih Ngen A Nitaklam Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

paite: Mihing tate aw, ka thupina bang tan ahia zahlakna a na suahsak ding uh? Bang tan ahia thil bangmah lou na thupisak ua, zuauthu na zon ding uh? Selah
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

paite: TOUPA Pathian limsakmi amah a ding in akoihtuam chih thei zaw un; amah ka sap peuhmah chiang in, TOUPA'N ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

paite: Kihta unla, thil hihkhial kei un; na lupna tung uah na lungtang un ngaihtuah unla, dai sipsip un. Selah
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

paite: Diktatna kithoihna lan unla, TOUPA gingta un.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

paite: Hoihna himhim kua'n ahia hon musak ding chite tampi a-om uhi. TOUPA, nang mahmah in na mel vak in hon sunvak in!
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

paite: Abuh leh a-uain uh ahong khan chiang a akipahna sang ua, kipahna thupizaw ka lungtang ah na omsak hі.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

paite: Khamuangtak in ka lum ding a, ka ihmu ding hi; TOUPA, nangmah mah na hi, kei kia a leng bittak a hon omsak gige.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
